name: livesync-workers-app
description: Single-tenant deployment of livesync-workers: LiveSync backend + MCP on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w livesync-workers && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit

VECTORIZE.description: Semantic search index. Enter **768** dimensions and **cosine** metric: the embedding model (Workers AI `@cf/google/embeddinggemma-300m`) requires them.

FTS_BUCKET.description: Stores the full-text search index. Any bucket name works.

OAUTH_KV.description: Stores MCP OAuth clients and tokens. Any namespace name works.

AI.description: Workers AI, used to compute note embeddings.

LIVESYNC_DATABASE.description: Database name you will enter in the Obsidian LiveSync plugin. Keep `vault` unless you have a reason.

LIVESYNC_USERNAME.description: Username you will enter in the Obsidian LiveSync plugin.

LIVESYNC_PASSWORD.description: Password you will enter in the Obsidian LiveSync plugin. Pick a long random string (e.g. `openssl rand -hex 24`).

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the admin login on the status page and when authorizing MCP clients.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Signs admin session cookies and internal requests. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.
